Name: Koa
Description: A people named in Ezekiel's allegory of Jerusalem's unfaithfulness, listed among the Babylonians, Chaldeans, Pekod and Shoa who came against her, and identified with Gutium in the Zagros.
BiblicalSignificance: Koa is one of the far names in Ezekiel's charge sheet, a people from the eastern mountains drawn into Babylon's orbit.
